body.title: Add the repository queue store
body.summary: New chat-queue-store.ts over node:sqlite (injected openDatabase): schema v1 (messages, lease, presence, meta), WAL, synchronous NORMAL, busy_timeout 5000, every write BEGIN IMMEDIATE; enqueue with the 500-row bound, head (queued or retrying, never skipping a retrying head), acknowledge with the lease in one transaction, finish's outcome mapping, cancel, dismiss, resend, attachCli, heartbeat, release, presence, windowAlive, takeOver and reclaim stubs returning false, dataVersion plus an own-write counter, and the schema-version guard.
acceptanceChecks: A message is acknowledged at most once, only with the lease free, and only when it is the head
Rows run in seq order and a retrying head is never skipped
done and detached-ended rows are deleted; stopped becomes failed 'stopped by the user'; live rows never exceed 500 and the 501st enqueue is refused with a note
Two processes on one file acknowledging one head: exactly one succeeds
A newer schema version, or a database that cannot be opened, is reported as unavailable

tests.name: chat queue store: enqueue, head, acknowledge and finish keep seq order, acknowledge a message at most once and only with the lease free, delete a done message, turn a stopped one into failed with a resend, and refuse an enqueue with a note at 500 live rows
chat queue store: two processes on one database file acknowledging the same head at the same moment: exactly one succeeds and the message is processing once
